posts.description: The verdict is still out whether I am enjoying writing these notes every Monday. Half of me thinks it is just another todo list item and the other half likes sharing a little bit more than a few instagram stories. But nonetheless, here is Note 5. AT MY DESK One of my favourite resources as a designer is Google Fonts. Particularly to find trending fonts that may only be in the zeitgeist for a few months and may not be worth purchasing. Here are 5 I have used on projects recently. AT HOME Tonight's dinner is a recent fav go-to recipe I saw online. Loaf Pan Chicken Shawarma. It is so easy to make, literally dump the marinated chicken in a loaf pan, bake for 45 minutes and then use in wraps or on rice. I am not going to be starting a food blog anytime soon, but basic ingredients are Greek Yogurt (or mayo, which I have used when I don't have yogurt in the fridge), olive oil, lemon juice, garlic and shawarma spices. posts.description: I'm late posting my Monday blog, but it is still Monday in the states so I am going to go with that. I have been working non-stop lately but on some pretty cool things so feeling grateful I get to do such a creative job for a living. So just a quick week in photos for you today. AT MY DESK I love drawing in procreate on the iPad but nothing beats a good old black ink in the sketch book. I don't even bother scanning it in, I simply grab a quick iPhone photo (usually in awful lighting) and bring it in to illustrator to do a quick "image trace" and voilà it is ready to use. AT HOME Guest Room is all ready (ok actually bathroom still needs to be painted and there is no carpet yet but whatever) so who wants to come stay!?! posts.title: Note 003
posts.description: Mondays sure come around quick! Busy busy lately with some fun work projects, logo, packaging, marketing flyers and stationery. My philodendron is growing like crazy and I think I need to switch out the pot and the climbing pole or prune and back, but I am scared to do anything when it just keeps growing! AT MY DESK Thought I would share one of the tools I use to keep my computer running in tiptop shape so it can perform how I need it to. I invest in a CleanMyMac yearly subscription and genuinely love it. It keeps my Mac feeling faster and smoother by clearing out all the unnecessary junk and files that build up over time. I am sure I could manually do everything this app does but the convenience of it and how well it works makes it a must have tool as a freelancer who relies solely on this computer functioning well.
